fields.statement: At 7f5581c4, verifier claude-code-2a4a1ece read the diff to internal/api/ci.go workflowTemplate and to cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/ci-install.txtar, then parsed the expected rhiza.yml with PyYAML. It still has the push (branches: [main]) and pull_request triggers and their check steps: --base origin/${{ github.base_ref }}, --base ${{ github.event.before }}, and the first-push check. It adds workflow_dispatch with inputs.sha required: true, and checkout ref ${{ inputs.sha || github.sha }} (fetch-depth 0). run-name is 'Rhiza ${{ inputs.sha || github.event.pull_request.title || github.sha }}'. The concurrency group is rhiza-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || inputs.sha || github.sha }}, with cancel-in-progress ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}. A step with if github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' runs rhiza check --base HEAD~1. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ci-install$ passed: the installed file cmp-matches the expected workflow. go test -trimpath ./internal/api with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset passed (TestCIInstall* included). A first internal/api run with the run's RHIZA_* env inherited had failed, which comes from that environment and not from this change.
